messages.content: 你是算法能力工厂的 Curator。下面是一次被验证器发现、随后修复成功的代码问题。把它提炼为一条可复用的经验（LessonRecord）：title 一句话概括，trigger 写现象/报错，fix 写通用的修复方法（不要只描述这一处改动），applies_to 填相关的条件标签（从 condition_tags 中选）。error_code 与诊断码一致。

<<CONTEXT>>
{
 "operator_purpose": "统计业务粘性特征",
 "diagnostic": {
  "code": "E_INTERFACE",
  "stage": "static",
  "message": "meta.params 与 __init__ 默认值不一致：[\"service_cols: meta=['online_security', 'tech_support', 'streaming_tv'], __init__=('online_security', 'tech_support', 'streaming_tv')\"]",
  "operator": "ServiceCountFeature",
  "hint": "实例化时 meta.params 会覆盖 __init__ 默认值，两处必须一致"
 },
 "code_diff": "--- \n+++ \n@@ -15,3 +15,7 @@\n         dependencies=[\"numpy\", \"pandas\", \"sklearn\"],\n-        params={\"service_cols\": [\"online_security\", \"tech_support\", \"streaming_tv\"], \"monthly_col\": \"monthly_charges\", \"total_col\": \"total_charges\"},\n+        params={\n+            \"service_cols\": [\"online_security\", \"tech_support\", \"streaming_tv\"],\n+            \"monthly_col\": \"monthly_charges\",\n+            \"total_col\": \"total_charges\"\n+        },\n         parent=\"ServiceCountFeature@1\"\n@@ -19,3 +23,3 @@\n \n-    def __init__(self, service_cols=(\"online_security\", \"tech_support\", \"streaming_tv\"), monthly_col=\"monthly_charges\", total_col=\"total_charges\"):\n+    def __init__(self, service_cols=[\"online_security\", \"tech_support\", \"streaming_tv\"], monthly_col=\"monthly_charges\", total_col=\"total_charges\"):\n         self.service_cols = service_cols",
 "condition_tags": [
  "has_missing_values",
  "has_categorical_features",
  "low_cardinality",
  "high_cardinality",
  "numeric_features",
  "string_typed_numeric",
  "id_columns",
  "linear_model",
  "scaled_features",
  "nonlinear",
  "mixed_features",
  "large_tabular",
  "imbalanced",
  "recall_first",
  "interpretable",
  "feature_importance",
  "sparse_features",
  "text_input",
  "time_tenure"
 ]
}
<</CONTEXT>>

Respond with a single JSON object only, no prose, conforming to this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"DiagnosticCode": {"enum": ["E_SYNTAX", "E_UNSAFE", "E_INTERFACE", "E_RUNTIME", "E_TIMEOUT", "E_SHAPE", "E_PROBA", "E_MUTATION", "E_NAN", "M_THRESHOLD", "M_UNSTABLE"], "title": "DiagnosticCode", "type": "string"}}, "properties": {"title": {"title": "Title", "type": "string"}, "trigger": {"description": "什么情况下会出现这个问题（现象/报错）", "title": "Trigger", "type": "string"}, "fix": {"description": "如何修复或规避", "title": "Fix", "type": "string"}, "error_code": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/DiagnosticCode"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}, "applies_to": {"description": "相关的算子名、条件标签或场景名", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Applies To", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["title", "trigger", "fix"], "title": "LessonRecord", "type": "object"}
